subject: maths
question: The speed of a truck is 220 kmph. Calculate the distance traveled by the truck in 50 seconds.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the truck = 220 kmph

Time = 50 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Speed in m/s = Speed in kmph × (5 / 18)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Speed in m/s = 220 × (5 / 18)

⇒ Speed in m/s = 61.111 m/s

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 61.111 × 50

⇒ Distance = 3055.5 m

**∴ The correct answer is 3055.5 m.**
